articles.summary: DuPont announced that a MemCor™ membrane bioreactor (MBR) system has been selected to support the upgrade of the Lower Molonglo Water Quality Control Centre (LMWQCC) in Canberra, Australia, the largest inland wastewater treatment facility in the country.
articles.title: Australia’s Largest Inland Wastewater Treatment Facility Selects MemCor™ MBR System for Expansion
DuPont Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call

articles.summary: DuPont announced the launch of AmberChrom™ SIL silica gel, a new reverse phase silica-based solution designed to support the purification and manufacture of peptide therapeutics, including glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists.
articles.title: DuPont Launches AmberChrom™ SIL Silica Gel for Chromatography to Advance Manufacturing of GLP-1 and Other Peptide Therapeutics

articles.summary: DuPont announced that its Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) team has been named a “Sustainability Squad” in the Business Intelligence Group's 2026 Sustainability Awards.
articles.title: DuPont Direct Lithium Extraction Team Named 2026 Sustainability Squad by Business Intelligence Group
DuPont Announces Regular Quarterly Dividend on Common Stock

articles.summary: DuPont announced that its net-zero science-based greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reduction targets have been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).
articles.title: DuPont Net-Zero Climate Targets Validated by Science Based Targets initiative

articles.summary: DuPont launched the DuPont Sugar Separation Advisor, an interactive digital tool designed to help sugar and sweetener manufacturers quickly evaluate chromatographic separation potential and identify candidate DuPont™ AmberLite™ resins for further testing.
articles.title: DuPont Launches Sugar Separation Advisor to Accelerate Sugar and Sweetener Purification
